# HEM v0.8.6b7 – Keep OFF monitoring active with fresh room sensors

Fix an OFF-monitoring gap in rooms with several selected thermometers: when one source became stale, normal control could still use the remaining fresh measurements while the shutdown watchdog discarded the whole room mean. The watchdog now follows the valid independent contributors to that same mean and validates their identity and count.

Stale readings and the controlled appliance's own temperature probe remain excluded. A change in contributing sensors starts a new observation interval, so a change of mean cannot fabricate a warming trend. Missing or inconsistent evidence still stops monitoring.

Heat-source attribution, device permissions, observation thresholds and the limit of two guarded OFF retries remain unchanged. Possible external heat can produce an unattributed warming diagnostic without sending an appliance-specific alert or an OFF command. This release improves software monitoring; it does not establish that a physical valve has closed or repair a Zigbee delivery or valve-mechanism fault.

Regression coverage exercises the real room-source adapter and watchdog with a stale third sensor, contributor changes, exclusion of the appliance probe, invalid evidence, the two-retry budget and unresolved external heat.
